Source_cause.Source_assessment: Old frame-based global profile callback obtains frame.f_code on Python calls including stdlib; that can create repeated Python/audit work. Code-local monitoring can cover intended target starts/resumes/throws with direct code arguments and exclude stdlib start/resume events. This is a Source overhead hypothesis, not a proven timeout cause or measured improvement.
Source_cause.classification: Two observed owned-child60s timeouts with no saved child status; no target Source defect or measured function-level cause established.
exact_constraints: PY_START|PY_RESUME local on recursively compiled target CodeTypes; PY_THROW global filtered by exact retained target identity.
Keep strong references and verify object identity, not structural CodeType equality or filename alone.
Use2-argument start/resume callback and3-argument throw callback.
Never return DISABLE; preserve target event50M andfunction-name4096 caps and explicit new event evidence labels.
Finally clear all local events, then global events, unregister callbacks, then free only owned unused tool5.
Preserve exact2 target compile/exec, audit/data-AST exception, literal imports,98 cases,60s wall/shared5s cleanup, resource floors and all target Source.
Actual new runner/template/bindings need separate different Source review+Root adoption and fresh one-use scope; no current invocation authority.
